notes:
Fixes for backup drives that drop out during uploads, plus smarter card matching.

- A backup drive that briefly disconnects no longer marks files as changed. Plug it back in and uploads carry on (press Resume if the transfer had already stopped)
- Files that earlier builds wrongly marked as changed are re-checked and uploaded
- Cards are recognised by the clips on them, so a reused card is never mistaken for an old one
- Each transfer shows its upload speed while uploading
- If this update won't install: download SafeStore.dmg from the beta releases page, quit SafeStore with nothing transferring, then drag the new SafeStore into Applications. Updates work by themselves after that
